topic: Fila do INSS cai de 1,9 milhão para 765 mil pedidos atrasados; governo quer zerar estoque até setembro Notícia Preta Brasil
insights: The backlog of INSS requests has significantly decreased from 1.9 million to 765,000.
The Brazilian government aims to eliminate the remaining backlog by September.
This reduction in backlog is part of a broader effort to improve the efficiency of the INSS system.

stats.context: percentage decrease in the backlog of INSS requests

quotes.text: The government is committed to zeroing the stock of pending requests.

summary: The Brazilian government has made significant progress in reducing the backlog of INSS requests, cutting it down from 1.9 million to 765,000. With a target to eliminate the remaining requests by September, this initiative reflects a commitment to enhancing the efficiency of social security services.
